The pre-deadline unsaved squad is not public and is not returned. This is the one endpoint that calls upstream while you wait, so it carries a short timeout; a second call for the same manager and gameweek is served from GET /api/squad/{managerId}.

info.title: fpl-backend
info.description: The only HTTP surface of the fantasy-premier-league stack. Every response is wrapped in the ApiResponse envelope by a global interceptor; `data` holds the payload and `errorCode` is the stable key to switch on. No authentication anywhere — the product reads the public FPL API only (decision D-013).

requestId.description: Echoed from x-request-id, or generated per request.

dataAsOfGw.description: Which gameweek's data produced this. Present on every response carrying model output.

errorCode.description: Stable machine-readable key on failure, e.g. MANAGER_NOT_FOUND. Null when success is true.

uptimeSeconds.description: Whole seconds since this process started.

playerId.description: Our internal player id (cuid), not the FPL element id.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million. 55 is £5.5m.

sellValue.description: What a sale would return, in tenths. NULL for an imported squad and that is correct: no public endpoint carries a purchase or selling price. Filled by the transfer planner (B-008).

slot.description: 1-11 starting XI, 12-15 bench in substitution order. Called `position` upstream, renamed here because a pick already has a position in the GKP/DEF/MID/FWD sense and one field cannot be both.

multiplier.description: 1 normally, 2 for the captain, 3 under the triple-captain chip.

managerId.description: The FPL manager id this squad was imported from. NULL for the recommended squad, which belongs to nobody.

managerName.description: The manager's display name, when the squad came from an import.

gameweekId.description: The gameweek this squad is the picks for.

bank.description: Money not spent, in tenths of a million.

teamValue.description: Squad value excluding the bank, in tenths of a million.

activeChip.description: The chip active in this gameweek, e.g. bboost or 3xc. Null when none.

source.description: Which of the three ways this squad arrived (D-013). The advice is identical for all of them — that is the point of one shape.

managerId.description: A public FPL manager id — the number in a manager's /entry/<id>/ URL on the official site.

message.description: Written for a person, not a log.

violations.description: EVERY broken rule, not just the first. A builder that reports one violation at a time makes the user play twenty questions with the form.

totalCost.description: Total cost in tenths of a million.

bank.description: Budget minus cost, in tenths. Negative means over budget.

positionCounts.description: How many of each position, against the quota.

clubCounts.description: How many from each club, against the 3-per-club limit.

playerIds.description: Our internal player ids (cuid). Order does not matter here.

components.description: Per-term breakdown of the next gameweek's expected points: appearance, goals, assists, cs, conceded, defcon, saves, bonus. The model's own reasoning, not a rationalisation.

expectedMinutes.description: Expected minutes in the next gameweek.

playProbability.description: P(the player features at all). The term that dominates every other one — a 9-point forward who might not start is worth less than a 4-point one who certainly will.

sd.description: Standard deviation of the points distribution (B-017). NULL for a projection written by a model version that composed none — read it as unknown, never as zero. A zero here is a claim of certainty.

pBlank.description: P(2 points or fewer — the appearance and nothing else). What a human means by a blank, and the number that separates two players with the same expected points.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million.

status.description: a=available d=doubtful i=injured s=suspended u=unavailable n=not in squad. Only "a" is safe to start. Carried here so a flag can sit on the shirt without a second fetch (plan 030).

news.description: The availability note, when there is one.

chanceOfPlayingNextRound.description: FPL’s own chance of playing next round, as a percentage. Null when FPL has published none.

role.description: What this player should do, not what the manager currently has them doing.

benchOrder.description: 1-4 for a bench player, in substitution order; null for a starter. Order is a real decision: auto-subs walk the bench in this order and the first eligible player comes on.

epNextGw.description: Expected points for the next gameweek alone.

epHorizon.description: Expected points over the horizon, decayed — the number the optimizer actually maximises.

evidence.description: Null when the model has no projection for this player in the next gameweek.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million.

squadHorizonEp.description: Horizon EP summed over this squad's 15.

optimalHorizonEp.description: Horizon EP summed over the optimal 15.

horizonGap.description: optimalHorizonEp − squadHorizonEp. Never negative: the optimal squad is optimal, so a negative gap would mean the comparison is broken, and a test asserts it cannot happen.

xiNextGwEp.description: Next-gameweek EP of the best XI from this squad, captain counted twice — what the manager should actually score if the model is right.

optimalXiNextGwEp.description: The same for the optimal squad.

formation.description: The formation the best XI from this squad plays.

optimalHasThatYouDoNot.description: In the optimal 15 and not in this squad. **Not a transfer recommendation** — a transfer costs money and possibly 4 points, and deciding whether one is worth it is the transfer plan (GET /insights/transfers/{managerId}, or POST /insights/transfers for a built 15). This is the set difference and nothing more.

youHaveThatOptimalDoesNot.description: In this squad and not in the optimal 15. Same caveat.

teamShortName.description: e.g. "CHE". Never a team id — see the collision note below.

appearances.description: Premier League appearances, archive plus this season. Below the threshold, which is why this player was not eligible.

epHorizon.description: Horizon expected points the unguarded solve valued them at.

threshold.description: Minimum appearances to enter the candidate pool.

excluded.description: How many of the league the floor removed.

costEp.description: Horizon EP the floor cost, measured against the same solve with the floor lifted and the collision penalty unchanged — so the number isolates the floor. Null when not computed.

wouldHaveMadeTheSquad.description: The excluded players an unguarded solve would actually have picked. Not "everyone below the threshold" — that list is hundreds long and says nothing about this recommendation.

statement.description: What this guard IS, carried in the payload so a UI cannot restate it more confidently than the evidence allows.

club.description: The club both play for — e.g. "BHA". Never a team id.

players.description: The two defensive players, by web name.

lambda.description: Horizon points charged for starting this pair together.

club.description: The club both play for — e.g. "BHA".

lambda.description: Horizon points charged per pair of our defensive players who START for the same club.

pairsHeld.description: Same-club defensive pairs the fifteen holds, started or not. A pair with one member benched is held and not charged — a user should still see it, because the money was spent.

penaltyEp.description: Horizon EP charged, which is for the started pairs only.

statement.description: What this guard is, and what it is NOT. The correlation behind it was measured over three archived seasons; the CHARGE is a policy choice, because nothing has measured that a narrower squad scores more. A UI must not present it as if something had.

managerId.description: The manager this advice is for. Null for the recommended squad.

gameweekId.description: The gameweek the advice is for — the next one.

horizonGameweekIds.description: Every gameweek in the horizon the epHorizon numbers cover.

modelVersion.description: Which projection model produced these numbers.

captain.description: Who to captain: the highest-EP player in the best XI. Null for an empty squad.

players.description: All 15, each with the role the model would give it and its evidence.

reasoning.description: Why the RECOMMENDED squad is what it is — which players the appearance floor removed and what that cost, and which fixture collisions the recommendation kept and what it paid. It describes the optimal squad, not the one being advised on, and is null only if the solve produced none.

notAdvisedOn.description: What this advice deliberately does not answer, in plain language, so the gap is visible in the payload rather than only in a plan file.

playerIds.description: Our internal player ids (cuid) for the 15.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million.

sellValue.description: What selling returns, in tenths: purchase price plus half the rise, rounded down. Null when the purchase price could not be reconstructed at all.

sellValueSource.description: Where the purchase price came from. 'transfer-log' is exact — the manager's own element_in_cost. 'starting-gameweek-price' is exact for a player held since their first gameweek, because FPL's per-gameweek value IS the price that week. 'market-price' is exact by construction: a hand-built fifteen was never bought, so every player sells for what he costs today. 'unknown' means the budget used the market price for a player who WAS bought, which overstates it.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million.

gainEp.description: Horizon EP this single move adds, before any hit. The hit is charged once against the plan, not per move, because it is a property of how many moves there are.

gameweekId.description: The gameweek the CALENDAR argues for, or null when none in the horizon does — which is the common answer early in a season, not a failure. Never a gameweek for the wildcard: nothing in a fixture list argues for one.

reason.description: Why, in the words a user would use.

spent.description: Already used, so there is nothing to advise.

managerId.description: Null for a plan from a hand-built fifteen (POST /insights/transfers).

gameweekId.description: The gameweek the plan is for — the next one.

freeTransfers.description: Free transfers in hand. For a manager, replayed from their own gameweek history — FPL exposes no free-transfer count publicly. For a hand-built fifteen, the number the user stated.

freeTransfersSource.description: 'reconstructed' from the manager's gameweek history; 'stated' by the user for a hand-built fifteen, which nothing here can check.

freeTransfersReconstructed.description: False when the replay had a gap in it, which makes the count a lower bound rather than a number. Always true for a stated count: it is whatever the user said, not a bound.

bank.description: Bank, in tenths of a million.

moves.description: Empty means hold — the solver always has holding available to it, so an empty plan is a decision and not a missing answer.

hitCost.description: Points those hits cost, as a positive number.

currentEp.description: Horizon EP of the squad as it stands.

plannedEp.description: Horizon EP after the moves, with the hit already subtracted.

netGainEp.description: plannedEp − currentEp. Never negative: holding is always in the solver’s feasible set.

sellValueUnknown.description: Picks whose sell value could not be reconstructed, so the budget used their market price.

caveats.description: What this plan is not, in the payload rather than only in a plan file.

playerIds.description: Our internal player ids (cuid) for the 15.

freeTransfers.description: Free transfers in hand, as the user states them — nothing here can check the number. Capped at the bank FPL allows (5).

bank.description: Bank in tenths of a million. Omitted, it is what the fifteen leaves of the budget at today's prices — what FPL would leave a manager who bought exactly this squad now.

playerId.description: Our internal id (cuid) — what the squad endpoints take.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million.

status.description: a=available d=doubtful i=injured s=suspended u=unavailable n=not in squad. Only "a" is safe to start.

news.description: The injury or availability note, when there is one.

epNextGw.description: Our expected points for the next gameweek. Null when the model has not projected this player — a null is not a zero, and the UI must not render it as one.

playProbability.description: P(features at all) next gameweek. The term that dominates every other one.

gameweekId.description: Which gameweek the expected points are for. Null when nothing has been projected yet.

count.description: Every player in the game. The list is bounded by the game itself — 612 in 2025/26 — so it is served whole rather than paged: a picker needs to filter across all of them at once.

appearances.description: Matches with a recorded stat row this season.

isHome.description: True when this player’s club is the home side.

difficulty.description: FPL’s fixture difficulty rating for THIS player’s club in this match, 1 (easiest) to 5. Read from the side the player is on, so a home player sees the home difficulty.

kickoffTime.description: ISO instant. Null when FPL has not scheduled the match yet.

expectedPoints.description: Expected points in this gameweek alone.

sd.description: Standard deviation of the points distribution. Null for a model version that composed none — unknown, never zero.

pBlank.description: P(2 points or fewer). Null when the model carried no distribution.

pHaul.description: P(10 points or more). Null when the model carried no distribution.

components.description: Per-term breakdown of the expected points: appearance, goals, assists, cs, conceded, defcon, saves, bonus, fixtures. The model’s own reasoning, not a rationalisation.

fixtures.description: The club’s fixtures in this gameweek. Empty is a blank, two is a double — both facts about the published calendar, not inferences.

points.description: FPL points actually scored in this match.

expectedGoals.description: Expected goals in this match, FPL’s own figure.

expectedAssists.description: Expected assists in this match, FPL’s own figure.

nowCost.description: Market price in tenths of a million.

status.description: a=available d=doubtful i=injured s=suspended u=unavailable n=not in squad. Only "a" is safe to start.

news.description: The availability note, when there is one.

chanceOfPlayingNextRound.description: FPL’s own chance of playing next round, as a percentage. Null when FPL has published none, which is the normal state for a fit player.

form.description: FPL’s form figure: points per match over the last 30 days. Null before any match.

pointsPerGame.description: FPL’s points per game this season.

seasonMinutes.description: Minutes played this season, FPL’s figure.

penaltiesOrder.description: 1 means first-choice penalty taker. Null when not on the list.

selectedByPercent.description: Share of FPL managers who own this player, as a percentage, from the latest ownership snapshot. Null when none has been recorded. Ownership is a fact about the crowd, never an input to the projection.

priceChangeSinceTracked.description: Price change in tenths since this app first tracked the player — NOT since the season started, which no stored row can say. Null with fewer than two price points.

priceTrackedSince.description: ISO instant of the first tracked price, so the change above can be dated.

seasonTotals.description: Summed from the per-gameweek stat rows. Null before the player has one.

modelVersion.description: The served model version the projections below came from. Null when nothing is projected.

horizonGameweekIds.description: The gameweeks a decision can still be made for, in order — the optimizer’s horizon.

projections.description: One entry per horizon gameweek the served model has projected, in gameweek order. Empty when the model has not reached this player.

recent.description: The last finished matches, newest first. Empty before the season’s first match.
